Actor.description:
A participant, declared in ``turn.start`` or an ``actor`` event before any event names it. A sub-agent carries
its ``parent`` actor and the ``tool_call_id`` that ``spawned_by`` it.
Actor.title: Actor

Attempt.description: A harness retry within the task; later events carry ``attempt`` equal to ``number``.
Attempt.title: Attempt

DataPart.description: A structured A2A part, such as a harness's tool-call count or a structured output.
DataPart.title: DataPart

DerivedFrom.description: The record an event came from: its position in the turn's stored native log, or in the named aux log.
DerivedFrom.title: DerivedFrom

Elision.description: Why content is missing, so elided never reads as empty. A redacted secret has its length and no hash.
Elision.title: Elision

ExtensionEvent.description: A ``<namespace>/<name>`` type, such as an adapter's raw native record: readers keep it and may skip it.
ExtensionEvent.title: ExtensionEvent

FinalMetrics.description:
A turn's totals under ATIF's FinalMetrics names. ``basis`` says whether they sum the turn's steps or are what
the harness reported; ``total_steps`` counts its ``step`` events.
FinalMetrics.title: FinalMetrics

oneOf.description: A type this version doesn't define: readers keep it, producers may not write it.
A type this version doesn't define: readers keep it, producers may not write it.

Metrics.description:
One step's usage, inclusive as in ATIF: ``prompt_tokens`` counts cache reads and writes, ``completion_tokens``
counts reasoning. An unknown count is null or absent, never 0; ``raw`` keeps the native counters.
Metrics.title: Metrics

Opaque.description: A provider payload kept byte for byte, such as a thinking signature, for replay.
Opaque.title: Opaque

Origin.description:
Where a user-side part came from; the part's own metadata (a notification's channel, a peer's id) sits beside
``kind``.
Origin.title: Origin

RefPart.description: Text over the inline limit: a preview and the full text by reference.
RefPart.title: RefPart

Source.description: Bytes held by reference: a ``sha256:<hex>`` URL resolved under the run's blob prefix, or an absolute URL.
Source.title: Source

StepEvent.description:
One inference, dispatch or inbound message, under ATIF's step names; the content events that share its
``step`` key belong to it.
StepEvent.title: StepEvent

Time.description:
When an event happened per the native record. ``at`` is always present and null when the native has no time;
``raw`` is the native string whenever it differs from ``at``.
Time.title: Time

ToolCall.description: A tool call; ``arguments`` is any JSON value, and ``arguments_raw`` the native string when it was one.
ToolCall.title: ToolCall

ToolResult.description: A result answering any earlier call in the context, kept where it arrived.

oneOf.description: A type this version doesn't define: readers keep it, producers may not write it.

ToolResult.title: ToolResult

Tools.description: The tools the agent can call from here on: the whole set, or ones added or removed.
Tools.title: Tools

TurnStart.description: Opens a turn, one per A2A task. It names who made the stream and declares the turn's actors.
TurnStart.title: TurnStart

oneOf.description: A type this version doesn't define: readers keep it, producers may not write it.
